accept_criteria: Description grounded in content_brief thesis and master selection evidence
Word count within configured band; correct person and voice
No invented credentials, quotes, or facts absent from upstream artifacts
Hooks and takeaways match narrative_arc_plan and coverage_audit
reject_patterns: Thin evidence or generic marketing copy without transcript grounding
Wrong person or voice (e.g. third person when first person required)
Claims contradict content_brief or show format_class
